skipped-tests.reason: Real skipped-script gap, but proposal ambiguously adds assertions already present instead of explicitly connecting the existing suite. Cannot safely count as useful.

ci-omits-tests.reason: Concrete CI syntax-only job versus existing runnable behavioral suite. Proposal links existing tests, signed verification concept, benefit, validation and rollback. Exact invocation still needs pnpm availability.

assertions-omitted.reason: No proposal despite the source test body containing no assertions; model stops without inspecting it.

already-satisfied.reason: No proposal for an already-supported check setup.

evidence-unknown.reason: scoring_invalid_prose; no valid score or suggestion. Not a valid no-proposal control.
